preservedSourceAttributes.policy: No geometry generated; original topology, JOINTS, WEIGHTS, IBM, UV, materials and VRM expression bindings remain pinned by exact body SHA.

featurePreservation.scope: Referenced eyes, eyeline, eyelashes and hair base plus every original individual morph endpoint. This extends explicit future readback beyond the old base-only displacement check.

contactBaseline.policy: New strict FaceMouth/Face_SKIN pairs remain failures. Existing strict and precision-boundary failures are retained without waiver.

sourceEndpointMeaning.0..N: each original source morph endpoint at full delta; Neutral binding is recorded separately

pairTriangleIdentity.order: triangle order in the exact primitive index accessor

predicate.scope: Frozen noncoplanar finite strict segment/triangle test; no coplanar or continuous-expression guarantee.

requiredReadbacks: same-position duplicate material points share consistent mapping
complete necessary domain coverage and positive volume cells
